//: tsconfig for the Bazel TS layer (the cached CI checks), NOT how Next consumes @repo/ui. Next compiles the .ts source itself via transpilePackages; this config only governs the `ts_project` leaves that produce the node-runnable unit-check outputs. Standalone (no `extends`) so each compile action's input set stays minimal, and commonjs/node so the emitted .js runs directly under node:test with no package.json "type" gymnastics. Gazelle reads `declaration` from here, so the rule attr isn't needed.
